subject: Request: Convert cohort promo credits into reserved discount for demo capacity
messages:
From: Sam Wilson <sam@launchleap.vc>
To: aisha_rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Convert cohort promo credits into reserved discount for demo capacity

Hi Aisha,

Quick note from LaunchLeap — we run a 12-week accelerator and have $30k in Redwood promo credits across the cohort that are expiring next quarter. For demo day we need stable, low-latency Dedicated capacity to run live demos for investors and partners, and the hosted credits don't reliably cover dedicated pool costs.

Is there a path to convert those promotional credits into a temporary reserved-capacity discount (e.g., a credit-equivalent discount applied to a Dedicated pool for a 6-8 week window)? That would let teams book and test with predictable latency. We can share usage reports and agree to a capped pool size.

Main asks:
- Convert up to $30k of promo credits into a timeboxed discount for Dedicated capacity
- Apply to a single pooled instance for the cohort (we'll nominate the account owner)
- Limited to demo day window (6 weeks recommended) with a hard spend cap

I attached a coarse usage report that shows their token patterns and peak concurrency. Happy to hop on a quick call.

Thanks,
Sam Wilson
Program Director — LaunchLeap Accelerator
sam@launchleap.vc
(415) 555-0192

Attachment: launchleap-usage-report.csv
From: aisha_rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
To: Sam Wilson <sam@launchleap.vc>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Convert cohort promo credits into reserved discount for demo capacity

Hi Sam — appreciate the note and the usage attachment, that helps.

Looping in Ben from commercial to model an option and Laura from legal to flag any contractual implications for Dedicated. A few clarifying questions to get us started:

- Is the $30k the total pool across all cohort accounts, or is it split per team?
- Do you want the discount to apply to a single Redwood Dedicated pool we create, or to a named customer account that will be billed (we can route credits either way but it changes invoicing)?
- Any compliance requirements we should be aware of for demo day (e.g., PII restrictions, need for on-prem/private env)?

Ben — attaching the usage CSV Sam sent. Can you sketch a short-priced conversion (credit -> % discount on Dedicated for N weeks) and a ceiling for exposure? If finance/legal prefer, we could instead convert credits into a prepaid reserved commitment that counts against their monthly Dedicated invoice.

Sam — I can also book a 30m call Thursday if that's easier.

Regards,
Aisha Rahman
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
+aisha@redwood.com

Attachment referenced: launchleap-usage-report.csv
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 08:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Convert cohort promo credits into reserved discount for demo capacity

Thanks — dug into the CSV. Peaks look short (2–4 hour spikes) and overall token volume is moderate. Two commercial approaches look workable:

Option A — Temporary discount mapping
- Convert $30k credits into a 20% discount on a Dedicated pool for 6 weeks
- Discount applied against actual Dedicated consumption up to a $30k exposure cap (once cap hit, standard rates apply)
- Requires simple amendment (pricing addendum) and finance sign-off

Option B — Prepaid reserved commitment
- Convert $30k into a prepaid Reserved Commitment that Redwood bills against (guaranteed capacity for 6 weeks)
- No post-cap exposure; would require a minimum commitment signature and DocuSign amendment

For speed, Option A is lighter operationally; Option B gives cleaner accounting for us but takes one extra step with procurement. I'm attaching a quick pricing calc (toy model) showing how the credit maps to discount at different pool sizes.

If legal needs SOC 2 addendum or additional T&Cs for Dedicated we should list those now. Also assigning a temporary internal deal_id: DL-2026-LL-042.

Ben
Director, Growth Partnerships — Redwood Inference

Attachment: pricing_calculation.xlsx
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 06 Nov 2026 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Convert cohort promo credits into reserved discount for demo capacity

Appreciate the modeling. A few legal/ops notes before we commit to Option A:

- We need a short amendment (pricing addendum) that specifies the timebox, spend cap, pool owner, and rollback behavior. I'll draft one but will require signature from LaunchLeap.
- Because this touches Dedicated (customer workload on reserved infra), our standard requirement is a SOC 2 addendum and a statement of expected data types. I've started a SOC 2 addendum draft (attached).
- If we go with Option B (prepaid), procurement prefers that we issue an invoice for the prepayment and reflect it as a credit on their account — that makes accounting simpler for LaunchLeap and us.

Please confirm which option the customer prefers; I'll put DocuSign-ready language together once they pick.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel — Redwood Inference

Attachment: soc2-addendum-draft.pdf
